title: SpreadsheetMetadata
description: Metadata describes the input spreadsheet content. Set this in `Part.spreadsheet_metadata` or `FunctionResponsePart.spreadsheet_metadata` when `inline_data` or `file_data` contains a spreadsheet to configure static spreadsheet preprocessing.

visibleCells.description: Optional. The range of cells to extract, in A1 notation (e.g. "A1:D10"). If not set, the full occupied area of the sheet is used.

contentLayers.description: Optional. Content layers to return. If empty, defaults to [DATA, FORMULAS] when SpreadsheetMetadata is set.

sheetIndex.description: Optional. The 1-indexed index of the sheet to extract, in workbook order. If not set, all sheets are extracted.
